paper.title: Asymptotic stability of solitary waves for one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equations

original_title_field: Asymptotic stability of solitary waves for one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equations
outcome: Three confirmed core proof defects (P1, P2, P9); six groups of local corrections; no established counterexample to Theorem1.1.
summary: The moving-frame equation omits -y*p_dot; the negative distorted branch has mixed rather than the printed local cubic dynamics; and Lemma13.4 has a false uniform remainder used by the core stationary-phase argument. Their all-hypothesis witnesses establish proof defects, not a false main stability theorem. Existing partial repairs do not amount to a complete corrected nonlinear proof.
limitations: Review applies only to arXiv2306.03668v1, 106 pages. Publisher full-text equivalence is not established.
No counterexample to Theorem1.1. P1 is a literal C1 coordinate-identity witness before orthogonality; P2 is an admissible spectral-profile witness, not an all-time trapped NLS trajectory.
Core repairs are specific and partly verified but do not certify every rewritten modulation, negative-channel reconstruction or continuity estimate.
Lemma13.4 counterexample meets every printed uniform norm hypothesis. Corrected local Holder step and full Lemma13.3 replacement do not constitute a complete new proof of every Lemma13.4 component.
The oH1 inference near14.7 and strongest scattering-profile regularity/continuity need independent high-frequency justification. No false nonlinear theorem asserted from absent justification.
All106 text pages read and67 source images actually viewed; full reading is not full independent proof reconstruction.
External spectral/resolvent theorems and complete cubic-quintic admissibility references were not fully independently reproved.
Bounded official-source and correction/supplement/code searches found no applicable extra; nonexistence not proved. No author code executed; absence of code is not a mathematical defect.
Native bounded assistants are AI auxiliaries, not human reviewers or independent acceptance. UI externally reported; runtime self-description separately recorded and backend unverified.

problems.title: Missing phase connection in the literal moving coordinate system
assumptions: Section8.1.1 permits arbitrary C1 frame parameters before orthogonality is imposed.
Use any actual admitted soliton Phi_omega and exact solution exp(-i omega t)Phi_omega. Choose p=A(t-t0), y=b!=0, gamma=omega t, and u(t,z)=exp(-ip(t)(z-b))Phi(z-b)-Phi(z).
This witness is a coordinate identity test, not a claim to satisfy later orthogonality or an entire trapped nonlinear orbit.
problems.proof: Direct differentiation yields the coefficient gamma_dot+p^2-p_dot(z-y). The RHS phase defect is a=omega-p^2-gamma_dot-y*p_dot. The literal printed equation has residual -A*b*(Phi+u) at t0, nonzero. The root SymPy script differentiates the complete unexpanded ansatz and verifies the chain rule.
problems.impact: The missing term y*p_dot is only O(t^-1+2alpha) from the preliminary bounds and cannot simply be discarded as integrable. The phase evolution and subsequent reconstruction rest on an incorrect exact equation. Major is based on this actual core derivation damage, not irreparability or a false main theorem.
problems.correction: Use the corrected connection a throughout, or consistently reparameterize the phase, and reconstruct physical gamma. For the geometric chart gamma=-gamma_geom-p*y, a=omega-p^2+gamma_geom_dot+p*y_dot.
problems.repair_verification: Conditional tail identity integral_t^infty y p_dot=-y(t)(p-pinf)-integral_t^infty y_dot(p-pinf)=O(t^-nu) follows from the intended p convergence and y growth. This checks reconstruction, not every rewritten modulation and continuity estimate.

problems.title: Negative distorted spectral branch has mixed cubic dynamics
problems.location: PDF36 (5.31), PDF50 (8.16), PDF92 (13.10), PDF98 Lemma13.5, PDF89 Proposition13.1, PDF99-100 phase ODE
assumptions: xi>0, R=[[r,s],[s,r]] unitary with s(0)=0, s(infinity)=1; spectral reality F_-=-R*conjugate(F_+).
Intermediate value supplies an actual xi* with |s|^2=|r|^2=1/2. Positive profile smooth compactly supported near -xi*, value a!=0, zero near +xi*; negative profile set by exact reality.
Profiles have zero trace at zero, weighted L2 and H1 regularity, arbitrarily small norms, and a physical-real inverse in the continuous spectral subspace. No entire trapped NLS trajectory claimed.
problems.proof: The sign sum gives Theta_-=bar(r)|A|^2bar(A)+bar(s)|B|^2bar(B), not -|C|^2C. At A=0,B=a,C=-bar(s)bar(a), discrepancy modulus |a|^3/(2sqrt2). Exact enumeration of all64 summands at s=3/5,r=4i/5,A=0,B=1 gives negative differences48/125 and-36i/125; actual-potential realization is supplied separately by continuity.
problems.impact: The asserted negative-branch local t^-1 cubic phase and its pointwise argument are false; this nonintegrable term cannot be hidden in the error. Main physical theorem not disproved.
problems.correction: From i F_+'=kN(F_+)+tau*xi*J F_++E derive iF_-'=-kR*N(RF_-)-tau*xi R*JR F_-+R*conj(E), k=L/(2t). Prove positive branch and reconstruct negative by reality, with sup bound sqrt2 and paired L2 unitarity. Fix positive phase signs in14.1-14.2.
problems.repair_verification: The tau discrepancy matrix R*JR+J has every entry containing r, so xi times it is a bounded order-zero multiplier and may be assigned to the integrable remainder. The negative cubic cannot. Section14 first physical component's propagating part is positive branch; strongest H1 continuity after all changes not certified.

problems.title: Multiplication and cubic identities omit continuous-input hypotheses
assumptions: a=1/2, L_a=-d_x^2-a(a+1)sech^2, H=diag(L_a+1,-L_a-1), phi=sech^a.
Smooth even exponential potentials; factorization proves only discrete eigenvalues±3/4, no embedded spectrum or threshold resonance, meeting H1-H3.
f=phi e1 is Schwartz; W=x exp(-x^2), cubic f=g=h and indices1 with L=0 satisfy the literal stated assumptions.
problems.proof: All input distorted transforms vanish. W phi e1 and W phi^3 e1 are nonzero odd vectors, hence continuous spectral because the only scalar bound state is even. Their transforms are nonzero, so the displayed identities fail. Factorization partner -d^2+a(1-a)sech^2 is positive; its zero-energy integration argument excludes threshold resonance.
problems.impact: The literal lemmas are overbroad. Applications already separate Ud/Ue, so projection restrictions and localized physical estimates preserve the required use; no counterexample to the repaired nonlinear estimate.
problems.correction: Require Pe input equality in both statements. Keep discrete terms physical; estimate W Xi_j Ue directly in H1 instead of applying a continuous spectral norm to Xi_j.
problems.repair_verification: Complete counterexample and projection repair relative to scalar short-range Jost asymptotics. Bounds of discrete contributions use localization and existing coefficient estimates.

problems.title: Incorrect local linearization sign and examples

assumptions: For the local null-mode formula use F(z)=z^2, omega1, Phi=sech x and positive slope; no main-theorem no-resonance claim.
Embedded example needs only H1-H2, not H3; V2=0 and V1=2sech^2 are allowed.
problems.proof: Printed V1=0,V2=-2sech^2 gives H(Phi,-Phi)=4sech^3(1,1). Printed embedded construction uses scalar -d^2-V1 eigenpair(sech,-1), but H(0,sech)=(0,-4sech^3), not eigen. F(z)=z^3-z^5 gives3|v|^4v-5|v|^8v and F''0=0.
problems.impact: Local sign and illustrative formulas are false, while the operative p4/p47-48 linearization is correct and embedded eigenvalues do exist. No core spectral conclusion counterexample.
problems.correction: V1=-F'-F''Phi^2; correct embedded example V1=-6sech^2, phi=sech^2 produces lower eigenvalue3; use F=z^2-z^3 for cubic-quintic.
problems.repair_verification: All stated identities checked exactly in the root script; examples restricted to their actual local hypotheses.

The Jost translation lemma needs H1-H2 only; zero potential is an admissible exact witness.
Local decay input g in H1 with g(0)=0.
problems.proof: At z1,k1 the proposed derivative-bound ratio is e^-1 b|i-xi/b|→infinity. For V0, translated fcheck1(x+100) has outgoing coefficient exp(100i xi), not1. Differentiating gF/xi contributes the omitted -gF/xi^2 term.
problems.impact: Three explicit local proof steps are wrong but the intended linear estimates retain their rates after the displayed repairs.
problems.correction: Use derivative bound C_k b^-k exp(-3zb/4); normalize translation exp(-100i xi); retain the IBP term and bound integral|g|/|xi| by H1 using trace0.
problems.repair_verification: Polynomial absorption proves the derivative bound;3sqrt2/4>1 covers every beta<1. The extra term is O(t^-1||g||H1), so no decay loss.

problems_checked.P1: Confirmed Major on the arbitrary C1-frame identity before later orthogonality: direct differentiation gives the coefficient omega-p^2-gamma_dot-y*p_dot. The stationary exact solution with p=A(t-t0), y=b nonzero and gamma=omega*t satisfies that ansatz and leaves the missing -Ab(Phi+u) residual. This is not a claim about an orthogonally selected nonlinear trajectory. The later chain through (8.26), (9.18), and estimate (12.13) was checked. A geometric-phase coordinate change must be explicit; y*p_dot need not be absolutely integrable from the printed bounds. The conditional tail integration-by-parts repair is not a reconstructed whole proof. Corrected the locator to estimate (12.13), Section 12.6, physical p87.
problems_checked.P2: Confirmed Major. Re-derived the positive/negative branch cubic algebra under the actual scattering unitarity and reality relations: Theta_-=conj(r)|A|^2 conj(A)+conj(s)|B|^2 conj(B), which is not -|C|^2 C. Continuity from zero to unit transmission supplies a realizable half-transmission frequency; a smooth positive-side profile supported near the reflected frequency, with negative component supplied by reality, realizes the discrepancy on the continuous physical subspace with arbitrarily small weighted H1 norm. The rational fixture alone was not treated as proof of realizability. The negative evolution requires R* N(RF-) and the transport conjugation. Positive-branch reconstruction remains a possible repair; no verified complete nonlinear-orbit or H1-continuity replacement is claimed.
problems_checked.P3: Confirmed Minor: the multiplication identities require continuous-spectrum projections. The a=1/2 short-range Poschl-Teller example has the required spectral properties, and multiplication of its even bound state by odd x exp(-x^2) yields a nonzero continuous component despite a zero input transform. Actual downstream input U_e already has the required projection. Native bounded source/evidence checking was read and compared with the complete report; no main spectral theorem was inferred false.
problems_checked.P4: Confirmed Minor local sign/example defects. Direct application of the printed cubic operator to (sech,-sech) gives 4 sech^3(1,1), whereas the actual main operator elsewhere has the correct sign. The cubic model is not claimed to satisfy the main no-resonance hypothesis. The embedded-eigenvalue scalar and cubic-quintic primitive corrections were checked as local examples, without extrapolation to the main nonlinear theorem.
problems_checked.P5: Confirmed Minor. The differentiated exponential ratio exp(-1)b|i-xi/b| is unbounded, while a weaker exponential bound suffices in the stated use. Translation of a zero-potential Jost solution requires its phase before the later centering hypothesis. The integration-by-parts correction includes -gF/xi^2 and the zero trace controls the repaired t^-1 H1 bound. Distinct local hypotheses and downstream scope were retained.
problems_checked.P6: Confirmed Minor normalization defect by tracing the unitary transform: the multiplication kernel has output-sign factor lambda/(2pi), the bilinear expression lambda*mu/(2pi), and the cubic m contains 1/(4pi^2). Reconciliation with the later mu=4pi^2*m preserves the checked positive-branch L/2 coefficient; the defect is not presented as a counterexample to that final coefficient.
problems_checked.P7: Confirmed Minor after checking actual p64 extraction against the earlier matrix: a0,a3 are imaginary and a1,a2 real; the scalar equations require omega_dot=-i*b0/c and p_dot=+b2/M. The boost energy identity has +2pP and the orthogonality cancellation leaves absorbable terms. Corrected the claimed source location from antecedent pp53-54 to the actual scalar extraction p64, preserving the earlier matrix as context.
problems_checked.P8: Confirmed Minor on the demonstrated local scope. The negative inhomogeneous cutoff sum is empty and the stated partition fails at the exact boundary. Independent scaled cutoffs with zero trace give the five stated delta powers. Maximum-frequency and product-frequency scales differ. No claim is made that every global dyadic summation has been reconstructed.
problems_checked.P9: Reclassified Major. The fixed-function PV test gives -i*sqrt(pi/2)*F(0); the source proof/application already use that constant, so that part alone is local. The separate moving bump F_t=c*t^(-1/2+3alpha/2)*eta(p/t^(-1+alpha)), xi=t^-alpha, kappa=alpha/2, 0<alpha<1/4, has F_t(0)=F_t(xi)=0 and satisfies all stated uniform bounds. Its normalized integral has a nonzero limit with strictly negative real part, exceeding all three printed remainder exponents by positive gaps. Thus the uniform Lemma 13.4 estimate itself is false. Its actual use p94 in Proposition 13.2 and then p98 in Lemma 13.5 makes this a core proof defect. Correcting the local H1 increment to t^-1/4 repairs one contribution only, not the full lemma. Independently checked the complete Gaussian/Fourier replacement for the distinct Lemma 13.3 optimization, valid for alpha<1/64. Neither repair supplies a full uniform Lemma 13.4 replacement. No counterexample to structured inputs of Proposition 13.2, a nonlinear trajectory, or Theorem 1.1 is asserted.
